verifiedProperties: Exact namespace, template ID, semantic version and template hash bind every assignment
Only template-eligible creator, exact-namespace governance or active same-context occupied-slot authority may assign or revoke
Account registration and capability issuance confer no implicit slot authority
A capability and an active exact actor-slot assignment are both required for action success
Cross-instance and cross-context subjects and assignment authorities are rejected
Duplicate active bindings and all assignment-ID reuse are rejected without imposing singleton slots
Separate immutable assignment and revocation records retain exact parent assignment IDs
Parent assignment or account revocation prospectively invalidates descendants; replacement parent IDs cannot revive old children
Instance revocation and expiry invalidate slot eligibility
Backdated mutations and action evaluation cannot evade a later recorded change
Denied actions consume neither nonce nor state, and failed operations do not advance the time watermark
Legacy capability, session, attenuation, fresh-key, scope, state and replay checks remain mandatory
Returned snapshots cannot mutate internal assignment, authority or revocation records
No universal administrator, implicit governance override or privilege collapse is introduced
